references.text: Psalm 49:16-17 speaks of how wealth cannot follow one into death, which resonates with the message in Matthew 6:19 about not storing up treasures on earth.
Proverbs 23:4-5 warns against striving for wealth, as it can suddenly disappear, similar to how Matthew 6:19 warns against the perishability of earthly treasures.

Luke 12:33-34 encourages selling what one owns and giving to the poor in order to store up treasures in heaven, paralleling the message in Matthew 6:19 about choosing heavenly treasures over earthly ones.
Hebrews 13:5 encourages being content with what one has and not being consumed by love of money, which reflects the warning in Matthew 6:19 against storing up earthly treasures.
